prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - maximize carbohydrate intake and energy around 15-mile training run scheduled for 10am

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks across one full day
Includes carbohydrate-focused meals with timing strategy around 10am training session
Provides calorie-dense, compact meal suggestions appropriate for endurance athlete needs
Formatted as concise 1-day plan (not excessive detail)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring calorie-dense, carbohydrate-focused nutrition with specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle building and strength gains through resistance training

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals distributed to support muscle recovery
Protein intake distributed across meals (minimum 30g per meal) totaling 1.6-2.0g per kg of body weight
Pre and post-workout meals included with appropriate macronutrient timing around resistance training
Plan is concise and compact (under 300 words) with clear meal times and portion guidance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution, muscle recovery, and meal timing around resistance training

prompt_inputs.goal: Prepare a 1-day meal plan for afternoon soccer match with quick meals and optimal hydration

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers breakfast, lunch, pre-match snack, and post-match recovery meal with minimal prep time
Includes specific hydration strategy with fluid volumes for before, during, and after the afternoon match
All meals are gluten-free and tree nut-free while supporting energy availability for soccer performance
Emphasizes easily digestible carbohydrates and appropriate timing to avoid gastrointestinal discomfort during competition
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (soccer player) balancing hydration, energy availability, and digestive comfort for afternoon competition with minimal preparation time
